title: Get Ready for Spring Planting in Winter
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: In many parts of the world, winter brings cold temperatures and, in some places, snowfall.
sentences.zh: 在世界许多地方,冬天带来寒冷的温度,在有些地方,降雪。

sentences.en: For people who like planting things, gardening may seem far away.
sentences.zh: 对于喜欢种菜的人来说 园艺可能看起来很遥远

sentences.en: However, during winter weather, there are still things a gardener can do to prepare for the spring.
sentences.zh: 然而,在冬天的天气中,园丁仍然可以做一些事情来为春天做准备。

sentences.en: Gardening expert Jessica Damiano recently wrote about such preparatory tasks for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 园艺专家Jessica Damiano最近为美联社写了这些筹备任务。

sentences.en: We can also call these tasks "prep work."
sentences.zh: 我们也可以将这些任务称为“准备工作”。

sentences.en: Testing seeds First let’s talk about seeds.
sentences.zh: 我们先谈谈种子。

sentences.en: If you have seed packets , she suggests checking their expiration date.
sentences.zh: 如果你有种子包, 她建议检查它们的过期日期。

sentences.en: That is the date by which they go “bad” or will not grow.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们“坏”或不会成长的日期。

sentences.en: Damiano says the seeds are usually considered “fresh” within a year of being packaged .
sentences.zh: Damiano说这些种子通常在包装后一年内就被视为“新鲜”种子。

sentences.en: But they can be used for longer than that.
sentences.zh: 但它们可以用来更长的时间。

sentences.en: However, you cannot be sure if the seeds are still good just by looking at a date.
sentences.zh: 但是,你不能确定种子是否还不错 仅仅看一个日期。

sentences.en: She suggests testing them. To do this, she places several seeds on a wet paper towel and then puts that into a plastic container.
sentences.zh: 她建议测试它们。为了这样做,她把几个种子放在湿纸巾上,然后把它放到塑料容器里。

sentences.en: In about 10 days, she will look to see how many seeds have sprouted.
sentences.zh: 大约10天后,她将看到有多少种子发芽。

sentences.en: This gives her an idea of how many seeds to use to get the desired number of plants.
sentences.zh: 这给了她一个想法 有多少种种子 用来获得想要的植物数量。

sentences.en: However, if less than 50 percent of the seeds sprout, she throws them away.
sentences.zh: 但是,如果不到50%的种子发芽,她会把它们扔掉。

sentences.en: Damiano tests her old seeds in the winter before the busy spring gardening season.
sentences.zh: 达米安诺在繁忙的春季园艺季节之前 在冬天测试她的旧种子

sentences.en: That is when seed and plant stores, or nurseries, can run out of seeds.
sentences.zh: 这就是种子和植物储存或苗圃能够用完种子的时候。

sentences.en: Inspect and care for equipment She also inspects her gardening equipment.
sentences.zh: 她还检查她的园艺设备。

sentences.en: For example, if you use grow lights — lights especially made for plants — make sure they still work.
sentences.zh: 例如,如果你使用生长灯——特别是为植物制造的灯——确保它们仍然有效。

sentences.en: You might have to buy new bulbs . Damiano brings out her grow lights and inspects each bulb.
sentences.zh: 你可能得买新灯泡 达米亚诺带出她的生长灯光 检查每个灯泡

sentences.en: If necessary, she will order replacement bulbs.
sentences.zh: 如有必要,她将订购更换灯泡。

sentences.en: That way she is prepared to plant at any time, even six to eight weeks in the future.
sentences.zh: 这样,她随时都准备种植,甚至在未来六到八个星期。

sentences.en: She also makes sure she has sterile seed-starting potting mix.
sentences.zh: 她还要确保自己有无菌的种子启动混合剂。

sentences.en: This is special soil for planting in containers.
sentences.zh: 这是用来种植容器的特殊土壤。

sentences.en: Damiano sharpens her cutting tools, such as pruning shears.
sentences.zh: 达米亚诺磨磨她的切割工具,例如剪剪。

sentences.en: Larger tools like lawnmowers should be inspected every year.
sentences.zh: 每年应该检查更大型的工具,如草坪草原。

sentences.en: Like nurseries, places that service lawn equipment might be busier in the spring.
sentences.zh: 像托儿所一样,在春天,提供草坪设备的地方可能比较繁忙。

sentences.en: You can get ahead of the crowd by getting your tools fixed early.
sentences.zh: 你可以提前把工具修好 赶在人群前面

sentences.en: Clean your gardening hand tools, like trowels and spades.
sentences.zh: 擦干净你的园艺手工具, 像燕子和黑桃。

sentences.en: Cover them lightly with oil. This will help keep them in good working order.
sentences.zh: 用油轻轻地遮住它们,这样可以使它们保持良好的工作状态。

sentences.en: Inspect things like hoses, sprinklers and other water systems for damage.
sentences.zh: 检查水龙头、喷洒器和其他水系统等损坏情况。

sentences.en: Make a list of anything you may need to replace or repair.
sentences.zh: 列出您需要替换或修理的物品清单 。

sentences.en: Damiano says that you could wait until spring to take care of all these things—but why?
sentences.zh: 达米安诺说,你可以等到春天再处理这些事情,但为什么?

sentences.en: Once spring arrives, you will have these tasks done.
sentences.zh: 春天一到 你就会完成这些任务

sentences.en: And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 这是《健康与生活方式报告》。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. Jessica Damiano reported this story for The Associated Press from New York.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo, Jessica Damiano 在纽约为美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编成VOA英文学习版。
